baseline: Arm D: fresh learner, DEFAULT dynamics (gain_lr=0.15, z_alpha=0.01, initial_var=1.0, gain_cap=2.0, reward_baseline=0.5), gains online from 1.0. Arm E: H0 reference — default dynamics, FROZEN phase-0 endpoint gains (TRANSFER-K4-RESTORE mechanism on the shifted task).
conditions: changing_rule v1.0.0; source 10x40=400 ticks (phase 0->1 flip); target 5x40=200 ticks phase-1-only via 5 throwaway resets; cue-indexed adapter; theta=0.45; capacity=3; test seeds {97011,97012,97013,97014}; tuning seeds {97001,97002,97003}; pilot {97021,97022} (design only). Deterministic seeded RNG throughout; no random.* in measurement.

arms.E: default dynamics, FROZEN phase-0 endpoint gains (H0 reference)

config.criterion: TTC = first 1-indexed tick t with mean(rewards[t-40:t]) >= 0.75; None if unreached within 200 ticks

gates.G1: tuned distinct from default AND no-worse on tuning seeds
gates.G4: TTC_E None on >=3/4 seeds (void if phase rules equal)

config.implementation: prototypes/architecture-a/experiments/transfer_dynamics.py (NEW, additive; K4 originals unmodified). reward_baseline parameterized via DynamicArbitrator(arbitrator_cls hook); gain update still only via broadcast feedback envelope.
config.source_task: changing_rule v1.0.0, 10 episodes x 40 steps = 400 ticks, phase 0->1 flip, cue-indexed adapter, theta=0.45, capacity=3
config.target_task: post-flip changing_rule v1.0.0: 5 throwaway resets -> episode_idx 5..9 (phase 1 throughout), 5 episodes x 40 = 200 ticks, gains from 1.0
config.tuning_protocol: deterministic coordinate descent, order [gain_lr, z_alpha, initial_var, gain_cap, reward_baseline], strict-improvement adoption, max 2 passes, criterion = tuning-seed mean total on source task

hypothesis: Learning DYNAMICS transfer where endpoint gains did not: a fresh K4 loop with dynamics meta-learned on the source task re-adapts to the shifted (post-flip) task >=30% faster than a fresh learner with default dynamics, on >=3/4 fresh test seeds.
interpretation: VERDICT: H0 — learning dynamics do NOT transfer (G2 0/4 wins, need 3). Tuning found real, distinct, better dynamics on the source task (all 5 params moved: gain_lr 0.15->0.30, z_alpha 0.01->0.05, initial_var 1.0->0.5, gain_cap 2.0->1.5, reward_baseline 0.5->0.7; source mean total 318.3->344.3, +8.2%; G1 PASS). But on the shifted task re-adaptation speed is unchanged: TTC_D = 40/40/43/40 vs TTC_X = 40/40/40/40 ticks. G3 no-harm PASS (4/4 reach both arms). G4 H0 reference PASS: frozen pre-shift endpoint totals 9-23/200, TTC None 4/4 — the endpoint actively hurts re-adaptation, reproducing TRANSFER-K4-RESTORE's mechanism. MECHANISM ACCOUNT (incl. floor-effect audit): the preregistered metric floors at TTC=40 (window=40), so 3/4 seeds sit at the measurement floor for both arms — the design could not resolve sub-40-tick differences. Exploratory finer-resolution re-runs (deterministic; labeled exploratory, NOT gated): window=20 shows D and X trajectories BIT-IDENTICAL on seeds 97011/97012 (dynamics change nothing — adaptation saturates), and X faster early on 97013 (first-20-tick mean 0.85 vs 0.65; w20/c0.75 TTC 20 vs 40) and 97014 (0.90 vs 0.75; w20/c0.80 20 vs 26). Even at the finest resolution only 1/4 seeds clears the 30% bar — H1 still unsupported. Conclusion: the K4 win's process-ness does not cash out as transferable hyperparameter dynamics. Re-adaptation from scratch reaches criterion in ~40 ticks regardless; the speed is a property of the loop STRUCTURE (broadcast feedback + delta rule + fixed baseline) meeting a clean cue signal, not of the specific dynamics constants. What transfers across tasks in this architecture: nothing measured so far — endpoint gains fail (H0, TRANSFER-K4-RESTORE), dynamics fail (H0, here). What survives is the loop itself, run long enough to re-adapt.
limitations: Single source/target pair (changing_rule phase flip); other shifts untested. Preregistered metric had a floor at TTC=40 (window=40); the confirmatory comparison is valid but coarse — the exploratory finer-resolution analysis is post-hoc and labeled as such. Tuning optimized source-task total reward, not re-adaptation speed; a dynamics search targeting speed directly might find different constants (untested). Coordinate descent over a 2-alternative grid per parameter is a coarse meta-learner; the true dynamics optimum is unmapped. reward_baseline is owned by DynamicArbitrator (payload field superseded, documented); the sole-path broadcast discipline is intact but the envelope field is vestigial for this arm.
null_hypothesis: Learning dynamics do not transfer: source-tuned dynamics re-adapt no faster than default dynamics ((TTC_D-TTC_X)/TTC_D < 0.30 on >=2/4 seeds), or tuning finds no distinct no-worse dynamics (G1 fails -> UNINTERPRETABLE).
preregistered_metric: time-to-criterion: first 1-indexed tick t with mean(rewards[t-40:t]) >= 0.75 over the 200-tick post-flip target run; None if unreached

summary.verdict: H0 — learning dynamics do NOT transfer: source-tuned dynamics re-adapt no faster than default dynamics on the shifted task (wins 0/4, need 3).
